notes: The Lean declaration captures the abstract finite-difference/cumulative inverse on supported arrays: \[ \mathrm{cumul}(\mathrm{diff}(f))=f,\qquad \mathrm{diff}(\mathrm{cumul}(f))=f. \] The paper's Proposition 3.1(a) uses the same algebraic mechanism to compare rank patterns \(r_{ij}\) and Kostant multiplicities \(m_{ab}\). The Lean declaration does not by itself assert that these arrays are precisely the rank patterns or Kostant partitions of an actual representation; those representation-theoretic bridges must be supplied by neighboring declarations.
summary: Lean proves \(\mathrm{cumul}\) and \(\mathrm{diff}\) are inverse on arrays; representation-theoretic realization is external to this declaration.
